content_of_post_to_comment: It is said you should not wait for motivation to come to you, it might never happen. Instead you have to just do it. But mental work, like learning something, seems more overwhelming to me than physical work like doing the house chores. I sit in front of the pc, open up my project and my brain just refuses to process what i read. How do you cope with such situations?
comment: I’ve found that mental work often has a bigger “startup cost” than physical tasks. Sometimes I’m not actually unable to focus, I’m just trying to jump straight into deep thinking from zero. I’ve had better luck opening the project and setting a tiny goal like reading one page or understanding one function instead of “working on it.” The momentum usually comes after starting.
